title: Generate Seedance 2.5 videos in 1080p via Higgsfield for higher-resolution…
content:
Generate Seedance 2.5 videos in 1080p via Higgsfield for higher-resolution output.  
Deploy a research agent to collect UGC-style reference ads similar to your product before prompting Seedance.  
Use Gemini 2.5 Flash to break down a reference creative scene-by-scene and have it insert placeholders for image references directly into the prompt.  
Use GPT-image 2 in Higgsfield to extract a representative frame from each cut/scene and attach those frames as image references in the prompt where the placeholders are.  
Send the final prompt plus all extracted frame references to Higgsfield’s video generator, select Seedance 2.5, and generate.  
After generation, finish the creative in a video editor by adding captions, cuts, zooms, and music.
